newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM says margins nearly at 1996 level.
newsitem.headline: DSM says margins nearly at 1996 level.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Tuesday profit margins in the first 1997 quarter had more or less recovered to year-earlier levels.
"Margins have on average recovered to almost the 1996 first-quarter level," DSM chairman Simon de Bree said in a statement.
DSM earlier reported first quarter ordinary net profits rose to 223 million guilders from a year-earlier 216 million.
DSM said that the uptrend in raw materials prices which started in the second half of last year were compensated by higher selling prices in the first quarter.
Higher margins on hydrocarbons and plastics had been offset by lower margins on fibre intermediates, melamine, elastomers and fertilizers, DSM said.
It said operating profits were up 10 million guilders year-on-year at 304 million due to higher sales volumes.
